responsibility: Provides the DFA scheduler model for Cortex-A5, covering its in-order integer, load/store, branch, and scalar floating-point pipelines. It defines reservations and bypasses for scalar ALU and multiply instructions, memory operations, branches, VFP arithmetic/divide/load-store, and core↔VFP transfers, giving the backend a latency/resource model for tuning code to Cortex-A5-class cores.
